title: On Reading and Living
excerpt: Reading expands our inner life and deepens our understanding of human experience.
content:
On Reading and Living

To read is to inhabit another way of seeing the world. Books do not simply inform us; they widen our imagination and sharpen our empathy.

Every meaningful book asks us to pause, reflect, and reconsider what we thought we already knew. In that sense, reading is not an escape from life but a deeper participation in it.
